sourceDecisionQuestions.question: The source vent term specifies ridge or box ventilation, while archived l’évent is generic. Confirm whether a French lesson face must preserve the subtype and how solin/tapajuntas around a vent is named for the selected roof assembly.

Pipe boot, flashing and cracked boot are material/detail-specific; archived manchon d’étanchéité and solin need qualified French/roofing terminology and the exact cracked-part referent before scoring.

The source gotera/leak is a possible water-entry outcome from a crack, not proof of a present leak. Confirm fuite versus toiture-specific infiltration sense; confirm skylight/puits de lumière versus roof-window terminology in this source context.

The source requires a photo of flashing around each penetration. Confirm the inspection/documentation scope for the selected job; archived speaking additionally asks what was photographed and for approval of flashing/fastener details, which is not in the source speaking objective.

The source commands sealing exposed nails without identifying product or repair method. Confirm product-specific treatment and whether archived réalisez l’étanchéité preserves the intended action before selecting a scored safety instruction.
